features.done-check: Lead, sample-out, quote, unconfirmed-order, and order-to-ship loops are created and updated from the specified channels; qualifying touches reset cold timing; shipping closes its order loop; an unapproved draft remains unsent and recurs in a later brief.

required_external_proof: Fresh Zoho Mail/Books accounts: verify actual test mail, approved expense and sale create/readback, invoice payment closure and current cash/invoice totals.
WhatsApp: verify configured test recipients, signed webhook hosting, actual brief delivery, owner tap/quoted reply/voice approval and closed-window approved templates.
Actual configured Meta text/vision model and Meta Voice service: verify real responses, source-backed facts and complete audio transcription.
Owner synthetic dataset review and provider record mappings; public shop allowlist and optional Instagram professional-account permissions.
Always-on public HTTPS hosting remains unselected; observe the real 08:00/18:00 Europe/London cycle for 24 hours.
Live use remains outside acceptance: verify current lawful basis and explicit owner authority before APP_LIVE=true.
